geometry_edits.rationale: Introduce a split-wing/courtyard structure to create a clearer public void and prevent the mass from reading as a sealed block.
Orient the split to support a street-facing opening and a more legible ground threshold.
Make the central void substantial enough to function as meaningful public space.
Keep a grounded spine so the composition retains one coherent primary mass instead of fragmenting.
Maintain a low public base while allowing the upper mass to vary above it.
Give the base enough width to read as an active street threshold rather than a thin connector.

graph_edits.rationale: Shift the dominant massing idea from a sealed compact prism to a courtyard-based public figure that can organize an active ground threshold.
Enlarge the void enough to read as usable public space rather than a superficial indentation.
Align the courtyard opening to the verified access side so the ground response addresses the street edge.
Lower the terrace linkage so the public threshold becomes more grounded and legible at entry level.
Preserve the compact bar logic but let the section read as a clearer short-span neighborhood volume rather than a generic box.
Move the embedded void to the access side so the street edge gains a legible public carve.

rationale: The candidate is coherent as one mass and the silhouette is reasonably resolved, but it reads as an introverted compact object rather than a neighborhood-living building with an active public threshold. Across the four views the form is mostly a sealed bent prism with only a weak, ambiguous ground response; the thick blue access edge is not met with a legible court, seam, undercut, or terrace. That makes the void/publicness and section-program logic weak for the brief. It also does not clearly fail as a shape, so repair integrity stays high, but the program contract is not satisfied because the dominant gesture does not visibly organize public ground space or mixed-use entry hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much taller tower precedent; its high-rise logic is not directly transferable to this low-rise neighborhood-living mass.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A compact prismatic mass can still read as a strong civic/commercial object when the top profile and overall body remain unified.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office tower typology is mismatched to the required active-ground neighborhood building.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A single dominant body with a subtle vertical taper can preserve legibility while introducing motion in section.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Restaurant reference is low, open, and frontage-heavy; candidate lacks that kind of explicit ground invitation.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A clear street edge can be softened by a canopy-like projection or a legible entry notch at the base.

warnings: Ground/access response is too sealed relative to the verified frontage edge.
Void is insufficiently public and reads more like a surface dent than usable space.
The mass is coherent in all views, but the program relation is under-articulated.
Avoid reading the stepped top as meaningful section support; it is too minor to carry the brief.
